reason: The target sets nomination, nominee consent, and two-thirds Council approval steps for life and honorary member registration.

proposedGroups.title: Life and honorary member registration process
proposedGroups.reason: The target sets nomination, nominee consent, and two-thirds Council approval steps for life and honorary member registration.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the nomination and approval process for life and honorary membership.

focusSelections.evidenceText:
2.3.2 Registration as a life member or an honorary
member shall occur as follows:
(a) Nomination shall be made to the Council in a
form prescribed by Council by two members,
both of whom must be land surveyor members.
(b) The nominee must agree to the nomination.
(c) The membership must be approved by a two -
thirds majority of the Council.
Revised January 2019

reason: The target describes Board approval and the academic or CBEPS-related criteria that can support surveyor-in-training registration.

proposedGroups.title: Surveyor-in-training registration criteria
proposedGroups.reason: The target describes Board approval and the academic or CBEPS-related criteria that can support surveyor-in-training registration.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the approval body and qualifying criteria for surveyor-in-training registration.

focusSelections.evidenceText:
2.3.4 Registration as a surveyor - in - training shall occur as
follows:
(a) An application for registration by a candidate
must be approved by the majority of the Board.
(b) Approval of the application by the Board will
be issued based on the applicant having one of
the following criteria:
i. possessing a certificate of completion
issued by the CBEPS;
ii. being successfully admitted as a CBEPS
Candidate;
iii. being enrolled in a program in surveying
at an academic level to the satisfaction of
the Board; or
iv. successfully having completed a diploma
or degree program in land surveying at an
academic level satisfactory to the Board.
Revised January 2019
